content_zh:
连胜：“不用。”
林冽点头。她也就是随便一问。
她抬手看了眼时间, 看起来真的很忙, 还是多问了一句：“在这里有人欺负你吗？”
这一次的事情, 显然是个乌龙。说实话, 她还是挺不高兴的。
“没有。”连胜说, “正常对决而已。”
林冽嗯了一声。
连胜从来不需要她操心, 两人间也没有什么共同语言。
林冽：“我走了。”
连胜朝她挥了挥手。
连胜慢腾腾走出大楼，外面太阳正好对着她的视线，有些刺眼。她抬手遮了下光, 甩着外套继续往前走。
没想到外面竟然有人在等她。
一个男生跟在她旁边问：“你刚刚是怎么做到的？一招制敌？你用什么打的？”
连胜笑道：“电击^枪。”
“哈哈，肯定不是。”那人比划着说，“电击^枪是可以查出来的, 但是医务室什么都没查出来, 所以肯定不是。”
连胜：“那就是拳头。”
“你这拳头……能把对方打成那样？”那人摸了摸鼻子，不大相信, 还是问道：“有什么高招？”
连胜勾起手指, 做了个手势, 然后往前作势一攻。
“哦……？”那男生跟着学了一遍, 将信将疑道：“真的假的？”
连胜说：“你猜。”
一战成名, 这是真真正正的一战成名, 各种意义上的。

来自连胜的神秘杀招，成了学院里最传奇的存在。甚至不到一个小时的时间，已经传遍四个年级各个系。
其中不少得力于对方教官那“见了鬼”一般的叙述。
他觉得自己是真的见了鬼。
连胜出来的时候, 已经过了饭点, 众人去过食堂都回来了。
迟到的人食堂不会提供吃食，而这里又没有超市之类的地方。等待她的是下午和晚上还有将近六个小时的高密度练习。
可以说非常悲催了。
还是休息时间，众人坐在早上集合的地方，等待下午训练开始。
连胜甩着那顶帽子，给自己煽风。旁边不停有人在往她这边窥觑。
似乎想跟她搭话，但是又不敢。
连胜低头一笑。当年那些小兵看见她的时候，就是这样的。
没多久，付教官走过来。
连胜感受到阴影，抬头看去。付教官冷着脸将袋子往前递来：“呐，吃了没有？”
连胜两手接过：“谢谢。”
里面装着两个包子，还有一杯豆浆。她拿出来满意地吃着。
付教官咳了一声，说道：“没有。今天误会你了，不好意思。”
连胜咬着包子的一角：“哦。”
付教官：“……”
他真心实意的道歉，就换来一个“哦”？
不。有“哦”就不错了，起码不是“滚”。连胜今天早上那表情，不是一般的阴沉。
他送完东西，又看了连胜一眼，决定默默走开。

半个小时后，休息时间结束，各教官开始带着学生正式训练。
第一天，就是越野跑步和耐力测试。教官带着他们在不同的山路上奔跑。
指挥系的路，一向是选最平坦的那一条。但只要是山路，路面不平，就会打乱脚步的节奏，极为消耗体力。他们队四十多个人，一共五个女生，穿山过林的，跑了半个多小时，彻底废了。
其中以连胜最佳，她实现了完美的打底。
付教官看她不对劲，专门跟在她身后，吹着哨子督促。
连胜脚步一慢，耳边就是那尖细的哨声。
她默默回头看一眼，然后继续跑。
体力是硬伤。就算连胜调整呼吸，调整步伐，依旧清楚感受到自己体能的上限。
身体的反应告诉她，该停了。于是坚持跑了一圈，回到集合地的时候，她停了下来。
付教官瞪眼，凑到她旁边疯狂吹哨。
连胜捂住耳朵，在原地抬脚走动，开始调整休息。
前面的女生一看，意志力瞬间被击溃，跟着停了下来。
付教官放下口哨，指着前面吼道：“跑起来！我没让你们停！”
几位女生决定看连胜行动。
连胜站在原地，脸色惨白，闻言只是轻轻瞥了他一眼。缓了许久，才小声道：“我跑不动了。”
付教官不听也知道她在说什么：“脚步迈起来就跑得动了，你这才跑了多远就说跑不动？”
连胜舔了舔齿间的血腥味：“我自己的身体，我最清楚。”
付教官：“你的训练量，我最清楚。”
连胜歪着脑袋叹了口气，伸出手横在他面前：“你自己把把脉。我已经极限了。”

content_en:
Streak: "No need."
Lin Lie nodded. She just asked casually.
She raised her hand and looked at the time. She looked really busy, so she asked one more question: "Is anyone bullying you here?"
What happened this time was obviously an error. To be honest, she was still quite unhappy.
"No." Lian Sheng said, "It's just a normal duel."
Lin Lie snorted.
She never needed to worry about the winning streak, and there was nothing in common between the two of them.
Lin Lie: "I'm leaving."
Streak waved at her.
Lian Sheng walked out of the building slowly. The sun outside was directly facing her line of sight, which was a bit dazzling. She raised her hand to cover the light, shook her coat and continued walking forward.
Unexpectedly, someone was waiting for her outside.
A boy followed her and asked, "How did you do that just now? Defeated the enemy with one move? What did you use?"
Lian Sheng smiled and said: "Electric shock gun."
"Haha, it's definitely not the case." The man gestured and said, "The stun gun can be detected, but nothing was found in the infirmary, so it's definitely not the case."
Streak: "That's fist."
"Your fist...can hit the opponent like that?" The man touched his nose and didn't believe it, but asked: "What's the trick?"
Lian Sheng raised his fingers, made a gesture, and then moved forward to attack.
"Oh...?" The boy followed suit and said doubtfully, "Is it true?"
Lian Sheng said: "Guess."
Become famous in one fight, this is truly become famous in one fight, in every sense of the word.
The mysterious killing move from Streak has become the most legendary existence in the academy. In less than an hour, it had already spread to all four grades and departments.
Many of them were helped by the opponent's instructor's "seeing a ghost" narrative.
He felt that he had really seen a ghost.
When the winning streak came out, it was already past dinner time, and everyone had returned from the canteen.
The cafeteria will not provide food for latecomers, and there is no supermarket or the like here. Awaiting her were nearly six hours of intensive practice in the afternoon and evening.
It can be said to be very sad.
It was still rest time, and everyone was sitting where they had gathered in the morning, waiting for the afternoon training to start.
Streak shook that hat and fanned the flames for himself. There were people constantly looking at her.
He seemed to want to talk to her, but he didn't dare.
Lian Sheng lowered his head and smiled. That's what those soldiers looked like when they saw her.
Not long after, instructor Fu came over.
Streak felt the shadow and looked up. Instructor Fu handed the bag forward with a cold face: "Hey, have you eaten?"
Lian Sheng took it with both hands: "Thank you."
There are two steamed buns and a cup of soy milk inside. She took it out and ate it with satisfaction.
Instructor Fu coughed and said, "No. I misunderstood you today, I'm sorry."
Lian Sheng bit a corner of the bun and said, "Oh."
Instructor Fu: "..."
His sincere apology only got an "oh"?
No. It's good to have "Oh", at least it's not "Go away". Lian Sheng's expression this morning was not ordinary gloomy.
After delivering the things, he looked at Lian Sheng again and decided to walk away silently.
Half an hour later, the break ended and the instructors began to lead the students for formal training.
The first day was all about cross-country running and endurance testing. The instructor took them running on different mountain roads.
The road to command is always the smoothest one. However, as long as it is a mountain road, the road surface will be uneven, which will disrupt the rhythm of the steps and consume a lot of energy. There were more than forty people in their team, five girls in total, and they ran through the mountains and forests for more than half an hour, and they were completely exhausted.
Among them, the winning streak was the best, and she achieved a perfect foundation.
Instructor Fu saw something was wrong with her and followed her behind, blowing the whistle to urge her.
As Lian Sheng's pace slowed down, the high-pitched whistle sounded in his ears.
She looked back silently, then continuedKeep running.
Physical strength is a flaw. Even if he adjusts his breathing and pace during the winning streak, he still clearly feels the upper limit of his physical ability.
Her body's reaction told her that it was time to stop. So she ran around for a while, and when she returned to the meeting place, she stopped.
Instructor Fu glared, moved next to her and whistled wildly.
Lian Sheng covered his ears, walked around on the spot, and began to adjust to rest.
When the girl in front saw it, her willpower was instantly defeated and she stopped.
Instructor Fu put down his whistle, pointed forward and shouted: "Run! I didn't let you stop!"
A few girls decided to watch Streak in action.
Lian Sheng stood there, his face pale, and he just glanced at him lightly when he heard this. After a long pause, he whispered: "I can't run anymore."
Instructor Fu knew what she was saying even if he didn't listen: "You can run as soon as you step up. How far have you run before you say you can't run?"
Lian Sheng licked the smell of blood between his teeth: "I know my own body best."
Instructor Fu: "I know your training volume best."
Lian Sheng tilted his head and sighed, stretched out his hand in front of him: "Feel your own pulse. I've reached my limit."
